nodes.label: examples workflow
nodes.rationale: Two jobs answering two questions: do the eight bundled frontends still install and build (#903), and do the standalone examples still run (#545). src/** is in the filter because of the snippets job and is the whole point of it — an examples-only filter would produce zero checks for exactly the failure this gate exists to catch.

nodes.label: example frontend build matrix
nodes.rationale: These directories had no CI coverage at all until now, and #890 is the worked example: ts-pattern was declared in all six example package.json files and missing from all six package-lock.json files, so npm ci failed everywhere on develop and nothing noticed. Deliberately `ci`, not `install`: only ci treats a desynced lockfile as an error rather than quietly rewriting it. The matrix is listed explicitly rather than globbed.

nodes.label: example snippets job
nodes.rationale: Until this existed, nothing in CI ever executed an example — a framework change could break every snippet in the tree and the only signal would be a user running one. Bun only, deliberately: the examples are written for Bun, so running them on Node and Deno would test the examples' portability rather than the framework's.
